# pxc_dns_a_record_set (Data Source)

Fetches dns a records for a specified host from the cloud internals bind dns server. Works just like hashicorp/dns provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The host to fetch records for.

### Read-Only

- `addrs` (List of String) List of IP addresses.
